en.text: I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.

zhSimplified.text: 看哪，仆人的眼睛怎样望主人的手，

zhTraditional.text: 看哪，僕人的眼睛怎樣望主人的手，

en.text: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你怜悯我们，怜悯我们！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你憐憫我們，憐憫我們！

en.text: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.

zhSimplified.text: 我们被那些安逸人的讥诮

zhTraditional.text: 我們被那些安逸人的譏誚
